$param.description: Declares a typed param, in the params of $method or $constructor

required.description: Whether it must be given, true by default

rest.description: Whether it takes all the remaining args, false by default

$callMethod.description: Calls a method of an instance

$className.description: Returns the class name of an instance

$getField.description: Returns a field of an instance

$hasField.description: Checks whether an instance has a field, returns bool

$instanceFields.description: Returns the fields of an instance as JSON

$instanceOf.description: Checks whether a variable holds an instance of a class, returns bool

$isInstance.description: Checks whether a variable holds an instance, returns bool

$new.description: Creates an instance of a class

variable.description: The variable to store it in

$setField.description: Sets a field of an instance

$classExists.description: Checks whether a class exists, returns bool

$classFields.description: Returns the fields of a class as JSON

$classMethods.description: Returns the methods of a class as JSON
